input:
Create a Splunk detection rule for MITRE ATT&CK T1070.001 (Clear Windows Event Logs).
Behavior to detect: Detects clearing of Windows event logs using wevtutil or the Security log cleared event.
Available data source: Sysmon EventID 1

output.title: Windows Event Log Cleared
output.description: Detects clearing of Windows event logs using wevtutil or the Security log cleared event.
output.sigma_rule:
title: Windows Event Log Cleared via Wevtutil
id: 1ea64121-c04f-599f-a362-9bf6966c0b0a
status: experimental
description: Detects wevtutil clearing event logs.
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wevtutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' cl '
      - ' clear-log '
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Administrators resetting logs on test systems
level: high
tags:
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.t1070.001
output.spl_query: sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=1 Image="*\\wevtutil.exe" (CommandLine="* cl *" OR CommandLine="* clear-log *") | stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by host User ParentImage CommandLine
false_positives: Administrators clearing logs on lab or test systems
response_actions: Treat as high priority: log clearing often follows intrusion.
Recover logs from Splunk (already indexed) for the period before clearing.
Investigate the user and process that ran wevtutil.
output.how_to_implement: Ingest Sysmon Operational logs (Splunk Add-on for Sysmon) with process creation (EventID 1) enabled.

input:
Create a Splunk detection rule for MITRE ATT&CK T1136.001 (Local Account).
Behavior to detect: Detects creation of a local account using net user with the /add switch.
Available data source: Sysmon EventID 1

output.title: Local User Account Created via Net Command
output.description: Detects creation of a local account using net user with the /add switch.
output.sigma_rule:
title: Local Account Created via Net Command
id: 31e23173-4b2c-5f4f-aa16-52c2b5d9544e
status: experimental
description: Detects net user /add.
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'user'
      - '/add'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - IT provisioning scripts
level: medium
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1136.001
output.spl_query: sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=1 (Image="*\\net.exe" OR Image="*\\net1.exe") CommandLine="*user*" CommandLine="*/add*" | stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by host User ParentImage CommandLine
false_positives: IT provisioning scripts creating local accounts
response_actions: Confirm with IT whether the account creation was authorized.
Disable the new account if unauthorized.
Check whether the account was added to Administrators.
output.how_to_implement: Ingest Sysmon Operational logs (Splunk Add-on for Sysmon) with process creation (EventID 1) enabled.

input:
Create a Splunk detection rule for MITRE ATT&CK T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer).
Behavior to detect: Detects certutil.exe used with urlcache or verifyctl to download files from the internet.
Available data source: Sysmon EventID 1

output.title: Certutil Used to Download a File
output.description: Detects certutil.exe used with urlcache or verifyctl to download files from the internet.
output.sigma_rule:
title: Certutil Used to Download a File
id: 09b2b970-9c87-5e20-930b-35c301791680
status: experimental
description: Detects certutil downloading remote files.
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\certutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'urlcache'
      - 'verifyctl'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Rare administrative use
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command-and-control
  - attack.t1105
output.spl_query: sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=1 Image="*\\certutil.exe" (CommandLine="*urlcache*" OR CommandLine="*verifyctl*") | stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by host User ParentImage CommandLine
false_positives: Rare legitimate administrative use of certutil to fetch certificates
response_actions: Extract the URL from the command line and check its reputation.
Retrieve and analyze the downloaded file.
Block the URL/domain and isolate the host if malicious.
output.how_to_implement: Ingest Sysmon Operational logs (Splunk Add-on for Sysmon) with process creation (EventID 1) enabled.
